text: sophia (Product Designer): putting this here — new compact suppression toggle in the alert preview. screenshot: https://redwood-internal.screenshots/abc123.png The issue: in dark mode the pill looks fine but when you tab to it the focus outline is the same color as the background so it appears like focus disappears. Also the SR announcement is currently just "button". thoughts? :eyes: maria (Accessibility): thanks for flagging. two quick things: 1) focus contrast in dark mode needs a 3:1 contrast relative to adjacent UI per our a11y kit. 2) use role="switch" with aria-checked and an accessible label so screenreaders say "Suppress notifications on/off" rather than "button". aj (Frontend Eng): agree re role=switch. quick prototype I tried locally — adding a 2px white outline + 1px transparent stroke fixed visibility but might be too heavy in the compact layout. here's what I used:```css .suppress-pill:focus { outline: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.9); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.25) inset; } ``` That preserves shape and doesn't shift layout. sophia (Product Designer): that looks better than the current. my worry is weight — the pill is 28px tall and sits next to badges; visually the thick outline competes. Could we instead do an inner ring + subtle glow? also need to make sure the pill doesn't expand when toggled (we had that bug where label width pushed the whole row). maria (Accessibility): inner ring is fine as long as contrast numbers meet requirements. Also keyboard focus should visibly show on :focus and :focus-visible, and we need to ensure high-contrast mode maps correctly. For SR, aria-live isn't ideal here — better to include aria-checked on the switch and a visually-hidden span that reads current state for pointer toggles. leo (Backend Eng): re: not expanding — that's probably caused by making the label visible on toggle instead of using visually-hidden text.
